title: Gautam Adani denies quid pro quo in US DOJ's decision to drop bribery case, says $10 billion investment proposal had no role
description: Industrialist Gautam Adani has told a United States (US) court that he is not aware of any quid pro quo for the US Department of Justice's (DoJ) decision to drop criminal charges against him and seven others in the alleged $250 million bribery case [USA Vs Gautam Adani].In an affidavit filed on July 15 before the United States District Court for the Eastern District of New York, Adani stated that he has no knowledge of anything promised, offered, sought, received, agreed to or accepted by anyone
